title: Stop the open-folder sheet deadlocking against the Quit confirm
notes: The quit question was asked with showMessageBoxSync, which stops the whole main process until it is answered. A folder panel already open could never finish, so projects:open never replied and the renderer showed "reply was never sent". Measured: the main process sat dead for 4.3 seconds in a stripped-down copy of the window. It now asks with the async showMessageBox: the close is always stopped, and answering Quit calls destroy(), which raises no close to answer again. A second close request while the question is up is ignored instead of stacking another question. PR #14.
